findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 6 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 6.1 8, 6.2 2, 6.3 2, 6.4 4, 6.7 2, 6.8 2, 6.9 2, 6.11 2.

12 pairs (theory 5 marks + numerical 3 marks) covering the kinetic theory assumptions, the ideal gas equation, PV = N k_B T, the gas laws, the density form ρ = PM/RT, internal energy, work W = PΔV, the first law, isothermal and adiabatic processes, the heat engine and second law, the Carnot cycle and its efficiency, the refrigerator and its co-efficient of performance, and entropy. Numericals use new values, recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: Charles' law about 1787, Example 6.1 volume 0.025 m³ (not 0.03 m³), the engine schematic is Fig. 6.8, and in Example 6.4 T₂ (not E) is the unknown.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
